resources.string: Private app-to-app pages from accepted contacts. NOOP does not contact emergency services.
Use a dedicated high-priority sound, vibration and light for Safety pages. Off by default. Android sound and Do Not Disturb settings still apply; NOOP never opens a full-screen alert.
Opt-in urgent sound, vibration and light for private NOOP Safety pages.
Show a fresh live heart rate in the existing background notification. Updates at most every 15 seconds to limit battery use; this does not turn on continuous heart-rate capture.
Heart rate in background notification. Does not start continuous heart-rate capture.
